/-- [binary_group46::reference]:
    Source: 'lib.rs', lines 6:0-12:1
    Visibility: public -/
def reference (a : Std.U32) (b : Option Std.U32) : Result Group := do
  let parent ← lift (Std.U32.wrapping_shr a 1#i32)
  match b with
  | none =>
    let i ← lift (a ^^^ 1#u32)
    ok { parent, consumed := 1#usize, sibling := (some i) }
  | some b1 =>
    let i ← lift (a ^^^ 1#u32)
    if b1 = i
    then ok { parent, consumed := 2#usize, sibling := none }
    else
      let i1 ← lift (a ^^^ 1#u32)
      ok { parent, consumed := 1#usize, sibling := (some i1) }

end AspisR1BinaryGroup46
